summary: Indexes are higher Friday morning as tech rebounds from the OpenAI revenue scare selloff, with oil slipping after Trump vowed no Iran strike before the midterms.
market_note: S&P 500 and Nasdaq on track for weekly gains; telecoms sinking after SpaceX agreed to buy a nationwide wireless spectrum portfolio.

items.why: September was Tesla's best China sales month this year at 95,366 wholesale units per CPCA data, plus Tigress reiterated a Buy rating with a $550 target.
No single headline; riding the broad megacap rebound with AI stocks recovering from yesterday's OpenAI revenue scare, helping lead the Dow's morning rally per MarketWatch.
